name: Terazosin Hydrochloride

fda.text: Syncope and “First-dose” Effect Terazosin capsules, like other alpha-adrenergic blocking agents, can cause marked lowering of blood pressure, especially postural hypotension, and syncope in association with the first dose or first few days of therapy. A similar effect can be anticipated if therapy is interrupted for…

summary: Terazosin Hydrochloride has an official warning that it can cause a sudden, severe drop in blood pressure, fainting, and blood pressure drops when standing up, especially around the time of the first dose or after pausing treatment [3]. Based on a small computer model rather than tests on people, the drug received a medium risk score of 63 for the liver [M]. That same computer model, which was not tested on people, gave the drug a low risk score of 37 for the heart [M].
